blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, Quezon — The Batangas City council is pushing for an ordinance regulating the use of electric bikes (e-bikes) and electric tricycles (e-trikes), particularly by minors, to prevent accidents and promote road safety. In a report on Tuesday, the city Public Information Office (PIO) cited Councilor Armando Lazarte, chairman of the Committee on Peace and Order and Public Safety, as saying that the city has recorded an estimated 1,550 accidents involving e-bikes and e-trikes. “Among the proposed provisions are a ban on minors and unqualified individuals from driving these vehicles, as well as holding parents or guardians accountable for allowing […]...
